answer_1.quote: We propose a synthetic data generation approach for fine-tuning embedding models, incorporating personae-based text generation to reflect different linguistic styles used by patients and healthcare professionals.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic phrases reflecting patient and healthcare professional perspectives for adverse event reports

answer_2.quote: Table shows the results for the baseline models, our fine-tuned embedding models, and comparisons between different re-ranking strategies: For the REN-Ode dataset, fine-tuning on real data generally outperforms synthetic data at lower Acc@n, though differences diminish at higher Acc@n levels.
